package handler

import (
	player "example.com/tcp-perf/game/entities/player"
	"example.com/tcp-perf/protocol/pb"
)

// 每次已接受请求恰好加一；重复请求不是幂等重试，客户端不自动重发。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAddGold(target player.IWalletEntity, _ *pb.AddGoldRequest) (*pb.AddGoldResponse, error) {
	return &pb.AddGoldResponse{Gold: target.WalletComp().AddGold()}, nil
}
